mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing moderate rain at Firemans Park with temperatures at 66 degrees.

The City of Verona is reaching out about cross connection surveys to protect our water supply, and don't forget that early voting for the November 3 election kicks off at City Hall starting October 20.
Today is a busy one with Yoga at Insight Wellness, an Art Bar Happy Hour, and trivia at Hop Haus, followed by live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow.
Looking at the records, on September 19, a 10-year-old child reported missing from Lincoln Street was safely located on North Nine Mound Road and reunited with their parents.
Treat yourself to today's flavor, Chocolate Heath Crunch, when the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
